# Snippets

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync.mjs from each snippet's header and choosing.md. Do not edit. -->

Built-in snippets only. Run `node <skill-dir>/index.mjs` for the full list, including custom blocks.

Pick from this index, then open only the files you chose. Each file starts
with a header comment (use, fits, limit, notes on filling it in) followed by
the markup to paste. Paste the markup only, not the header. All the CSS is
already in template.html, plus any custom.css next to custom blocks.

## Shells (pick exactly one)

| Shell | Use when | Used by | File |
|---|---|---|---|
| directory | The reader wants to find things: links to repos, Terraform, SharePoint, dashboards, runbooks, and the people to contact. | one-pager | `shells/directory.html` |
| explainer | The reader wants to understand something: how, why, what it is. Most topics. | one-pager | `shells/explainer.html` |
| report | Several figures (charts, diagrams, comparisons), usually over more than one printed page. | summarize-in | `shells/report.html` |

## Blocks

| Block | Use when | Fits in | Limit | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| callout | The takeaway, or the one thing not to miss (how to escalate, the one rule). | end of a column, or its own directory section | One per page, 1-2 sentences | `blocks/callout.html` |
| chart | Sourced amounts (bar) or change across an ordered scale (line). | wide column, half of row even, full width | 1-2 series; bar 2-8 bars; line 3-12 points | `blocks/chart.html` |
| command | A command, config or query people copy. | any column, directory section | 1-6 lines; 2-3 per page | `blocks/command.html` |
| comparison | Two to four options against the same criteria. | full width (above the shell, between rows, or directory section.span) | 2-4 options, 3-7 criteria | `blocks/comparison.html` |
| contacts | Who to ask: area, name, role, email or channel. | full width (directory: section.span) | ~10 people | `blocks/contacts.html` |
| diagram | A flow, sequence, structure or state machine that is clearer drawn. | wide column, or full width between report rows | One per printed page; ~6 nodes in a column, ~12 full width | `blocks/diagram.html` |
| facts | Short label / value pairs: owner, version, region, cost. | narrow column | 3-8 rows | `blocks/facts.html` |
| link list | Repos, sites, dashboards and docs to visit. | directory section, narrow column | 2-8 links per list | `blocks/link-list.html` |
| paragraph section | The explanation itself, in prose. | wide column | 2-4 sentences per paragraph | `blocks/paragraph-section.html` |
| point list | Parallel points, reasons or features. | wide column | 3-6 items | `blocks/point-list.html` |
| row | A wide + narrow column pair inside the report shell. | report shell |  | `blocks/row.html` |
| stat row | Two to four numbers that ARE the point: a price, a deadline, a growth rate. | full width (above the shell or between rows) | 2-4 tiles | `blocks/stat-row.html` |
| steps | An ordered procedure where order matters. | any column | 3-7 steps | `blocks/steps.html` |
| terms | A glossary: words the reader must know. | narrow column | 3-8 terms | `blocks/terms.html` |
| timeline | History, a rollout plan, or deadlines. | narrow column, directory section | 3-6 entries | `blocks/timeline.html` |

## Choosing between similar blocks

- **Understand or find?** A reader learning how something works gets the
  explainer (or report) shell. A reader looking things up gets the directory.
- **Options against the same criteria** → comparison. **One option's details**
  → facts.
- **Label / value pairs** (owner, version, cost) → facts. **Words to define** →
  terms.
- **Order matters** → steps. **Order doesn't** → point list. **Dates or
  phases** → timeline.
- **Two to four numbers that are the point** → stat row. **A pattern across
  many numbers** → chart. **One number** → say it in the text.
- **A flow, sequence or structure** → diagram. **Amounts or a trend** → chart.
  Never both for the same idea.
- **The one thing not to miss** → callout, once per page. If everything is
  important, nothing needs a callout.
- **Nothing fits** → a plain paragraph or list. Don't invent markup or CSS;
  tell the user which block was missing.
